summary: Create, edit, archive, and delete accounts (holdings) — an encrypted record whose unit doubles as its rate symbol and whose dims map holds at most one value per dimension by construction, with server-side atomic cascade delete on purge.

read.role: the archive flow's closing snapshot and the upsert rule the closing-snapshot field follows
money-figure typography, the Archived chip and destructive-action conventions for the account form and detail header, and the shell whose content width this screen sets

recordShape.value: record_type: "account", account_id empty; payload { name, unit, dims, note, archivedAt, createdAt }

unitIsRateSymbol.value: there is no separate rate-symbol field; unit is either a symbol table entry or free text, and doubles as the rate symbol

dimsShape.value: dims is a map of dimension id -> value id, both 8-char [a-z0-9] opaque ids from the profile's dimension config; carries no display text

note.value: free text, optional, null when unset

archivedAt.value: null for active accounts, otherwise the ISO date archived

nameUniqueness.value: account names need not be unique; record_id is identity

unitChangeLock.value: changing the unit is blocked, client-enforced only, once the account has >=1 snapshot, because unit lives inside ciphertext the server cannot validate

purgeEndpoint.value: DELETE /api/accounts/<account_id>?mode=purge — server-side atomic cascade of the account record and every snapshot with that account_id; the one deliberately type-aware exception to record-api.md; another user's account_id returns 404, not 403

deleteDialogOptions.value: an account with snapshots offers Archive (default, preselected, with an optional closing snapshot dated archivedAt prefilled 0) or Delete permanently (typed-name confirm, cascades); an account with no snapshots skips the dialog and is deleted outright

unassignedRendering.value: a missing dims entry, or a dims value naming an archived/nonexistent dimension or value, renders as 'Unassigned'; the entry is never stripped from the account record

fixtures: a configured dimension set (at least one multi-value dimension and one flag) with accounts assigned, for the dims-map and Unassigned-rendering criteria
an account with an existing snapshot, for the unit-change-lock and archive-closing-snapshot criteria
two users each owning an account, for the purge cross-user 404-not-403 criterion
an account name/note/dimension label containing ``, for the XSS-rendering criterion
focus: the unit-change-lock criterion is explicitly client-only ('the test asserts the UI refuses it — not that an API call is rejected, which the server cannot do') — do not write a server-side test for this and call it complete
purge must be tested for atomicity with a simulated mid-delete failure, not just a happy-path cascade
'no account record contains a rate symbol distinct from its unit' is a shape assertion — verify the schema has no such field, don't just check a sample record
the archive-with-closing-snapshot criterion needs the chart-interpolation behavior checked too (net-worth-view.md), not just that the snapshot record was written

dims-map single-entry-per-dimension is 'true by construction' per the spec — the test should guard the shape (a JSON object can't carry a duplicate key) rather than attempt to construct the invalid state and check it's rejected
